title: Shikonin induces ferroptosis in osteosarcomas through the mitochondrial ROS-regulated HIF-1alpha/HO-1 axis.
authors: Lu, Congcong; Zhang, Zhen; Fan, Yuhao; Wang, Xiyu; Qian, Jin; Bian, Zhenyu
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究紫草素通过线粒体ROS调控HIF-1alpha/HO-1轴诱导骨肉瘤铁死亡，属于纯细胞与动物实验，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The most common malignant bone tumour is osteosarcoma, which has an unsatisfactory prognosis and unsatisfactory treatment. Ferroptosis shows promise as an effective OS therapy. A substance extracted from the Lithospermum erythrorhizon, Shikonin (SHK), inhibits a number of tumours, including ovarian, gastric, and lung cancers. However, whether SHK induces OS ferroptosis and its mechanisms are not clear. PURPOSE: Our study is aimed at investigating whether SHK causes ferroptosis and elucidating its molecular mechanism. METHODS: Cell counting Kit-8, cell cycle and cell apoptosis assay were utilised to assess therapeutic effect of SHK against OS. Normal cells, including H9C2, AML-12 and HK-2, haematoxylin and eosin staining and mice serum biomarker tests were used to assess SHK biosafety. Malondialdehyde (MDA) levels, the glutathione (GSH)/oxidized glutathione (GSSG) ratio, reactive oxygen species (ROS), lipid peroxide (LPO), and intracellular Fe(2+) detection, quantitative reverse transcription PCR (qRT-PCR), Western blotting (WB) and rescue experiments were employed to confirm whether SHK induced ferroptosis in OS cells. Molecular docking, cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA), and drug affinity responsive target stability (DARTS) assay were used to evaluate the direct binding between SHK and hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha). Protein stability and degradation analysis, small RNA interference, flow cytometry, qRT-PCR, and WB were used to investigate the molecular mechanism of ferroptosis. In vivo xenografts of nude mouse was used to study the anti-OS effect of SHK. RESULTS: SHK significantly reduced OS cell viability and induced apoptosis and G2/M arrest. SHK increased intracellular levels of MDA, ROS, LPO, and Fe(2+) while simultaneously reducing the GSH/GSSG ratio and GPX4 and SLC7A11 expression. CETSA and DARTS results demonstrated that SHK did not bind targetly to HIF-1alpha. Instead, mitochondrial ROS (MitoROS) promoted HIF-1alpha expression, resulting in HO-1 overexpression, excess Fe(2+) production, ROS accumulation and GPX depletion, and ferroptosis. Furthermore, inhibition of MitoROS using Mito-TEMPO downregulated HIF-1alpha/HO-1 axis and mitigated the SHK-induced ferroptosis. In vivo, SHK effectively suppressed OS growth with favourable biosafety, confirming the molecular mechanism underlying SHK-induced ferroptosis in OS. CONCLUSION: We observe that HIF-1alpha/HO-1 axis is the crucial factor in SHK-induced OS ferroptosis. Importantly, we demonstrate that HIF-1alpha is indirectly regulated by MitoROS rather than SHK bound directly to HIF-1alpha. Our research suggest that SHK is a potential drug candidate for OS treatment and may help in identifying novel therapeutic targets for OS.
abstract_zh: 背景：最常见的恶性骨肿瘤是骨肉瘤（osteosarcoma, OS），其预后不佳且治疗效果不理想。铁死亡（ferroptosis）作为一种有效的OS治疗策略显示出潜力。从紫草（Lithospermum erythrorhizon）中提取的紫草素（Shikonin, SHK）可抑制多种肿瘤，包括卵巢癌、胃癌和肺癌。然而，SHK是否诱导OS铁死亡及其机制尚不清楚。目的：本研究旨在探讨SHK是否引起铁死亡，并阐明其分子机制。方法：使用细胞计数试剂盒-8（Cell Counting Kit-8）、细胞周期和细胞凋亡实验评估SHK对OS的治疗效果。正常细胞（包括H9C2、AML-12和HK-2）、苏木精-伊红（hematoxylin and eosin）染色和小鼠血清生物标志物检测用于评估SHK的生物安全性。通过丙二醛（MDA）水平、谷胱甘肽（GSH）/氧化型谷胱甘肽（GSSG）比值、活性氧（ROS）、脂质过氧化物（LPO）和细胞内Fe(2+)检测、定量逆转录PCR（qRT-PCR）、蛋白质印迹（Western blotting, WB）和拯救实验，确认SHK是否诱导OS细胞铁死亡。分子对接、细胞热位移分析（CETSA）和药物亲和力响应靶标稳定性（DARTS）实验用于评估SHK与缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1α）之间的直接结合。蛋白质稳定性和降解分析、小RNA干扰、流式细胞术、qRT-PCR和WB用于研究铁死亡的分子机制。裸鼠体内异种移植瘤模型用于研究SHK的抗OS效果。结果：SHK显著降低OS细胞活力，诱导凋亡和G2/M期阻滞。SHK增加细胞内MDA、ROS、LPO和Fe(2+)水平，同时降低GSH/GSSG比值以及GPX4和SLC7A11表达。CETSA和DARTS结果表明，SHK未靶向结合HIF-1α。相反，线粒体ROS（MitoROS）促进HIF-1α表达，导致HO-1过表达、过量Fe(2+)产生、ROS积累和GPX耗竭，进而引发铁死亡。此外，使用Mito-TEMPO抑制MitoROS可下调HIF-1α/HO-1轴，并减轻SHK诱导的铁死亡。在体内，SHK有效抑制OS生长且具有良好生物安全性，证实了SHK诱导OS铁死亡的分子机制。结论：我们观察到HIF-1α/HO-1轴是SHK诱导OS铁死亡的关键因素。重要的是，我们证明HIF-1α受MitoROS间接调控，而非SHK直接结合HIF-1α。我们的研究表明，SHK是OS治疗的潜在候选药物，可能有助于识别OS的新型治疗靶点。
